items.quote: I first went to Monika when I injured my back and neck. My injury prevented me from training for running races and doing circuit training but already after my first appointment with Monika I was more mobile and the pain had reduced. The follow up exercises I was given to do at home were also very helpful. After a few appointments I was able to return to my usual activities. I would highly recommend Monika she is excellent at what she does.
items.author: Sarah F, Keynsham Bristol

items.quote: Monika is very knowledgable & gave me some great advice whilst helping me with a recent back problem. I'm now out running again and feeling happy. Would highly recommend.
items.author: Becky M, Keynsham Bristol
